sources.title: google/gemma-4-12B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This model card summarizes details on the models' architecture, capabilities, limitations, and evaluation processes. A responsibly developed open model offers the opportunity to share innovation by making VLM technology accessible to developers and researchers across the AI ecosystem.

sources.title: Gemma 4 12B: The Developer Guide - Google Developers Blog
sources.snippet: Meet Gemma 4 12B: the first medium-sized, encoder-free multimodal model capable of natively ingesting audio and video. Ideal for local AI development with 16GB VRAM, Hugging Face integrations, and drop-in local API servers.

sources.title: google/gemma-4-12B-it · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This model card is for the Gemma 4 12B Unified model, which is part of the Gemma 4 family of open models. Built with the same multimodal functionality as Gemma 4 E2B and E4B (text, audio, image, and video inputs), it brings native audio and vision understanding directly to local environments without the need for separate encoders.

sources.title: Gemma 4 12B: Specs, Benchmarks & How to Run It Locally
sources.snippet: Gemma 4 12B is Google's encoder-free multimodal model that runs on a 16GB laptop. Specs, benchmarks, how it compares to Qwen & DeepSeek, and setup.

sources.title: Gemma 4 — Google DeepMind
sources.snippet: Gemma 4 models undergo the same rigorous infrastructure security protocols as our proprietary models. By choosing Gemma 4, enterprises and sovereign organizations gain a trusted, transparent foundation that delivers state-of-the-art capabilities while meeting the highest standards for security and reliability.
